depiction.primary_object: five-pointed star half filled on the left side
modifiers: left half solid black fill, right half thick outline
depiction.composition: single centered geometric shape, front view

readings.meaning: rating or review score (specifically half-star increments)
favorite or bookmark with partial status

ambiguity: At very small sizes, the half-fill might blur and look like a regular solid or outlined star (generic favorite/important marker).

modifier_semantics.meaning: partial rating, score, or evaluation rather than a binary bookmark

task_intents: write a review for a purchase
rate a restaurant or hotel stay

reasoning: A half-filled star universally represents ratings, scores, and user reviews rather than a simple favorite or bookmark (which uses a full or outline star). It fits everyday tasks around leaving reviews for purchases, stays, and services or managing customer ratings, though it can be confused with a plain star at tiny sizes.
